attributes.morphology: hypereutectic with micrometer-sized primary TiFe dendrites in ultrafine eutectic matrix

evidence.quote: Figure 2a shows Ti65Fe35 alloy having a hypereutectic structure with micrometer-sized primary TiFe dendrites (the whole dendrite may have a total size of even millimeters) distributed in an ultrafine eutectic matrix.
the lamellar spacing in the ultrafine eutectic matrix in Ti65Fe35 alloy is 0.5–1.5 μm

attributes.morphology: eutectic colony with fine eutectics inside and coarse eutectics outside separated by primary TiFe dendrites

evidence.quote: The (Ti 65Fe35)96.15Sn3.85 alloy displays a refined eutectic matrix with a lamellar spacing of 0.5–1 μm as shown in figure 2b. The volume fraction of the primary TiFe dendrites in (Ti 65Fe35)96.15Sn3.85 alloy is ≈25%.

mechanisms.name: lattice mismatch induced coherent strain at A2/B2 interface

evidence.quote: Sn and Nb additions increase the lattice parameter differences between β-Ti and TiFe phases. The larger lattice mismatches will introduce coherent strain at the interface of the β-Ti and TiFe phases, which may favour the absorption of dislocations emitted from the β-Ti(Fe, Sn, Nb) phase during deformation and provide better slip transfer at the A2/B2 interface
